findings.title: [SECURITY NOTICE] Bitget exchange hot wallets Incident, September 24, 2026 (vendor first disclosure)
findings.summary_md: Bitget's original security notice, timestamped 2026-09-24 21:39 on the page, reports that unauthorized transfers from hot wallets were detected at 18:31 UTC on September 24, 2026 and estimated at approximately $351.6 million. It states cold wallets remained fully secure under Bitget's three-tier wallet architecture, that only part of the hot and warm wallet layers was affected, and that the User Protection Fund holding over $464 million covers the loss. Withdrawals were suspended as a precaution and authorities and on-chain security firms were formally notified.

findings.title: Hackers steal $351.6 million in Bitget crypto exchange hack (first news coverage)
findings.summary_md: BleepingComputer's first report on the incident, published September 25, 2026 at 04:33 AM (site displays US Eastern time, 08:33 UTC), says Bitget discovered the breach Thursday evening after security systems flagged multiple unauthorized transfers and engaged Mandiant and SlowMist plus law enforcement. CEO Gracy Chen linked the theft to North Korean hackers based on IP behavior patterns and on-chain analysis, said attackers compromised a critical backend system in the wallet infrastructure to spoof transaction data and trigger the authorization process, and listed the affected chains as Ethereum, XRP Ledger, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Optimism, BSC and Base. The article predates any mention of the zero-day exploits, which were first revealed on September 30.

findings.title: Bitget Security Latest Incident Update: Fund Tracing and Recovery Bounty Program (vendor, revised loss and attacker addresses)
findings.summary_md: This vendor update, timestamped 2026-09-25 14:05 on the page, revises the loss to approximately $387.5 million, up from the initial $351.6 million estimate, after adding affected assets on Zcash and TRON, and confirms the underlying vulnerability had been identified and remediated with no further unauthorized transfers possible. It publishes the primary attacker-controlled receiving addresses (EVM 0x770b10b273fc44fe9197d6bf20f145c2e98463ee, XRP rwNhefsz1UQEusxhCvHip3RANinWi4CTck, ZEC t1WgMdtND8NF7NDUuYmq8MpMj1NTCXkMDVG, TRON TBWNguTTgezw9dVorX441C6nDrZpRxYwKD), a real-time tracing dashboard and API at trace.bgblockchain.xyz, and a Recovery Bounty Program paying 5 percent of funds frozen or recovered, run with Bybit's LazarusBounty as a core channel.

findings.title: Bitget resumes Bitcoin withdrawals after $387.5 million crypto heist
findings.summary_md: Published September 28, 2026 at 05:25 AM (site displays US Eastern time, 09:25 UTC), this report says Bitget resumed Bitcoin withdrawals and stated it had addressed the exploited vulnerability. It details the phased resumption schedule: ETH withdrawals on September 29 at 8:00 UTC, USDT on September 30 at 8:00 UTC, and other tokens, fiat and P2P assets starting October 2 at 8:00 UTC. It also notes the September 25 vendor update revising the theft to $387.5 million and launching the 5 percent Recovery Bounty Program.
